description: Defines abstract classes and interfaces for GPU vertex buffer management in Direct3D, including reference counting, buffer initialization, storage, and attribute handling.

classes.name: VertexBuffer
classes.description: Abstract class managing GPU vertex buffer with reference counting and serial tracking.

classes.name: VertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Base class for vertex buffer interfaces, managing buffer size, serial, and buffer access.

classes.name: StreamingVertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for dynamic streaming vertex buffers.

classes.name: StaticVertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for static vertex buffers with attribute matching.

classes.name: AttributeSignature
classes.description: Helper class for attribute signature matching in static buffers.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the vertex buffer with specified size and usage.

methods.name: storeVertexAttributes
methods.description: Stores vertex attribute data into the buffer.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the buffer.

methods.name: storeStaticAttribute
methods.description: Stores static attribute data into the buffer.

methods.name: matchesAttribute
methods.description: Checks if the attribute matches the stored signature.
